description: This script contains functions related to setting up and configuring Lantiq DSL systems, including detection of system type and configuration of network interfaces and modems.

methods.name: lantiq_is_vdsl_system
methods.description: Determines if the current system is a VDSL system by greping system type information in /proc/cpuinfo.

methods.name: lantiq_setup_dsl_helper
methods.description: Sets up the DSL helper configuration by checking for necessary modules and configuring modem types and WAN interface based on system type.
